name: lru_cache
description: A stateful class where order of operations matters (recency and eviction).

mutants.name: holds one item too many
mutants.patch:
--- a/cachekit/lru.py
+++ b/cachekit/lru.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        if len(self._data) > self.capacity:
+        if len(self._data) > self.capacity + 1:
